guarantees.claim: uart_rxto_en is always equal to the timeout enable CSR field reg2hw.timeout_ctrl.en.q.
uart_rxto_val is always equal to the timeout value CSR field reg2hw.timeout_ctrl.val.q.
rx_fifo_depth_changed is 1 when rx_fifo_depth does not equal rx_fifo_depth_prev_q, else 0.

rx_timeout_count_d is set to 0 when uart_rxto_en is low, event_rx_timeout is high, rx_fifo_depth_changed is high, or rx_fifo_depth is 0. On rx_tick_baud it increments by 1; otherwise it holds rx_timeout_count_q. Conditions are evaluated with the stated priority.
event_rx_timeout is asserted when rx_timeout_count_q equals uart_rxto_val and uart_rxto_en is high.

assumptions.claim: rx_tick_baud must be a single-cycle pulse every baud-rate interval when the timeout is enabled.
assumptions.risk: If rx_tick_baud is stuck high or asserted for multiple cycles, the counter increments uncontrollably, causing immediate or repeated timeout events.

assumptions.claim: Software must set the timeout value CSR field (uart_rxto_val) to a non-zero value when the timeout feature is enabled.
assumptions.risk: A zero timeout value causes the event_rx_timeout to assert immediately when rx_timeout_count_q becomes 0 (which happens after reset or FIFO empty) while FIFO is not empty, leading to spurious timeout interrupts.

assumptions.claim: rx_fifo_depth is a stable, glitch-free, synchronous signal that accurately reflects the FIFO occupancy; rx_fifo_depth_prev_q correctly holds its previous registered value.
assumptions.risk: Glitches on rx_fifo_depth can cause false rx_fifo_depth_changed assertions, leading to unintended timeout counter resets and missed or spurious timeout events.

assumptions.claim: The consumer of the combinational event_rx_timeout must synchronize or register it to avoid spurious interrupts due to glitches.
assumptions.risk: Glitches on event_rx_timeout could cause false interrupt assertions, potentially causing software to act on a non-existent timeout.

uncertain_points.claim: rx_fifo_depth is used directly in a combinational equality compare to generate rx_fifo_depth_changed. If rx_fifo_depth can glitch (e.g., due to pointer comparisons), spurious counter resets may occur.
uncertain_points.cond: When FIFO read/write operations may cause temporary indeterminate depth values
uncertain_points.risk: Unnecessary clearing of the timeout counter, leading to missed timeouts or false timeout events that could confuse software.

uncertain_points.claim: event_rx_timeout is a pure combinational signal; if it is used as an interrupt without a synchronizing register, glitches could produce false interrupt pulses.
uncertain_points.risk: Spurious interrupt assertions may cause software to misinterpret the UART status, potentially leading to incorrect data handling or error recovery.
